purpose: Freeze the same-contract multiplex and flow-control journeys used by the io-http2-v1 P1 gate before the first timing sample.
common_setup_outside_measurement: one persistent dedicated event worker and one external admitting and waiting caller per route
one complete route-ordered warmup episode per workload

common_semantics.transport: one fresh nonblocking Unix socket pair with 4 KiB send and receive buffers per charged episode
common_semantics.request: POST /v1/completions over h2c prior knowledge with Content-Length and an exact byte-validated body
common_semantics.multiplex: submit one complete fixed request, keep its stream active, submit the second, then allow the server to respond only after both streams are accepted
common_semantics.response: HTTP status 200 with Content-Length; the complete second response crosses the transport before the first starts, and the client verifies reverse completion order
common_semantics.body_lifetime: both routes copy received DATA into session or adapter-owned bounded stream storage, expose and validate at most 16 KiB per consumer step outside the protocol callback, and retain capacity only for the charged session lifetime
common_semantics.flow_control: automatic window updates disabled; every adapter- or reader-consumed DATA chunk returns both stream and connection credit after validation rather than inside the receive callback
common_semantics.progress: one external owner dispatches the episode to one persistent worker and waits for all client and server state to retire
common_semantics.failure: any session, framing, method, path, status, byte, length, ordering, syscall or completion mismatch invalidates the process

same_contract_matrix.candidate: public HYLE client/server sessions complete and validate the declared number of request-response streams
same_contract_matrix.peer: direct public nghttp2 client/server sessions complete and validate the same streams

same_contract_matrix.candidate: one external harness owns a persistent Scheduler worker; session and stream objects are created and retired inside every timed episode
same_contract_matrix.peer: one external harness owns a persistent worker; session and stream adapter objects plus owned header/body storage are created and retired inside every timed episode

same_contract_matrix.candidate: typed Status/Result checks invalidate the episode; no failure is injected in this success-path P1 row
same_contract_matrix.peer: the adapter maps every callback, nghttp2 and syscall failure to the same invalid episode; no failure is injected

same_contract_matrix.candidate: deadline and cancellation are disabled for this successful journey; destruction retires the session after all streams complete
same_contract_matrix.peer: no deadline or cancellation is armed; destruction retires the session after all streams complete

same_contract_matrix.candidate: two active streams per pair, serial fixed-body production, reverse response completion, 64 KiB stream windows and the declared connection window
same_contract_matrix.peer: the adapter enforces the identical submission sequence, reverse response sequence and windows; its bounded reader retains DATA outside callbacks and returns both explicit credits only after each validated consumer chunk

same_contract_matrix.candidate: both endpoints run cooperatively on one dedicated Scheduler worker while the caller only admits and waits
same_contract_matrix.peer: both endpoints are pumped on one dedicated worker while the caller only admits and waits

same_contract_matrix.candidate: runtime and payload setup are outside; socket, HTTP/2 state, all protocol work, validation and retirement are charged
same_contract_matrix.peer: runtime and payload setup are outside; the identical episode boundary is charged

same_contract_matrix.candidate: HYLE stream/session state uses its injected system allocator and reusable wire buffers
same_contract_matrix.peer: direct nghttp2 and the bounded adapter use their natural allocators; allocation count and bytes are measured product-route outputs

same_contract_matrix.candidate: source-built static HYLE wrapper over the pinned nghttp2 object code with LTO disabled
same_contract_matrix.peer: direct calls to the same pinned nghttp2 object code in the same executable and toolchain

workloads.consumer: a retained inference connection carrying pairs of overlapping small JSON requests and token-response bodies
large prompt or artifact-control messages that must make progress through both HTTP/2 window levels without whole-body session buffering

negative_space: the peer adapter calls nghttp2 rather than implementing HPACK, frames or protocol state
HTTP/1, TLS handshakes, listener accept, application routing, authentication, gRPC schema and batching are not charged

this gate proves public-wrapper non-inferiority over its pinned protocol mechanism for the fixed successful journeys; it is not an all-server, WAN, TLS, all-body-distribution or Formal SOTA certificate
